workItem: Persist the post-merge terminal work-claim release pattern as a reusable bounded Self-Healing learning process with promotion gated behind at least three positive validations.

firstValidation.observedOutcome: Terminal merged work claim is deterministically identifiable and a bounded status=released/exclusive=false mutation can be prepared from exact post-merge evidence.

invariants: No autonomous work-claim mutation while the target remediation action is HELD.
Promotion requires at least three distinct positive validations.
Promotion eligibility never self-enables the action; an explicit Human/CODEOWNER-merged contract change remains required.
Release is bounded to status=released and exclusive=false for claims whose associated work is terminal and evidence-correlated.

releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
